## Status Summary

| Metric | Champion | Last PASS Candidate | Delta |
|--------|----------|---------------------|-------|
| Tuning Mean | **3.530** | 1.762 | -50.1% |
| Tuning Min | **1.576** | 0.051 | -96.8% |
| Lockbox Mean | **4.061** | 1.793 | -55.9% |
| Lockbox Min | **3.318** | 1.347 | -59.4% |
| Worst MDD | N/A | -11.2% | — |

## Assessment

✅ **Champion Retained**: `champion_v5_latest.json` remains the best performer.

The last PASS candidate (`exp_macro_alpha_shadow`) cleared minimum thresholds but significantly underperforms the champion across all metrics. No promotion warranted.

## Recommended Actions

```bash
# 1. Run module-level experiments with auto-selection
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py \
  --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
  --run --select-best

# 2. Run system-level candidate sweep
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py \
  --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml \
  --run

# 3. Generate diagnostic report for next iteration
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py \
  --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
  --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

## Notes
- Champion lacks MDD metrics — consider backfilling for complete risk profile
- Large gap between champion and candidates suggests exploration in different parameter regions may be needed
- Next fix report should prioritize modules with highest improvement potential

Ready to proceed with commands when instructed.
